subject: Atlas demo recording + slides — quick Q&A?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Atlas demo recording + slides

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time to chat today. I enjoyed learning more about Atlas Health's patient intake workflow and the throughput/latency constraints you mentioned on the call. Per our discussion, attached are: the demo recording and the slide deck we walked through.

Attachments:
- Atlas-demo-recording.mp4 (recording, ~22m)
- Atlas-demo-slides.pdf (slides + architecture notes)

Quick recap / next steps we discussed:
- Key goal: reduce inference latency on triage models to <150ms 90th percentile while lowering per-token cost.
- Potential approach: short-listing two model variants (quantized Llama-2-70b-opt + a trimmed 13b variant) and testing with your sequence-length distribution.
- Tech next step: can we get a small eval dataset (50–100 sample conversations) and permissions to run a short benchmark?

If it helps, happy to set up a 20-minute Q&A to walk through the recording and answer any questions from your engineering team. I have some availability this week and next — here's a 15/20-min slot link: https://cal.redwood.ai/marissa/15.

No rush — let me know what works and I’ll coordinate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

--
